description: A 100% private and local AI assistant for your desktop. Always present, able to jump into conversations. Supports unlimited MCP tools and unlimited memory with self-learning. Free WisprFlow alternative with its dictation support. Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.
summary: Private local AI assistant for your desktop. Voice and text chat, personal memory, dictation and MCP tools. Runs offline with Ollama or OpenAI-compatible servers on macOS, Windows and Linux.
